flags.title: No automated snapshot has been verified yet
flags.detail: The current repository had no match feed or odds dataset. The collector only publishes records when the Hotspawn page exposes an identifiable League of Legends selection and match cards. Until a successful run, coverage is unverified and no picks are fabricated.

flags.title: External odds API access is not configured
flags.detail: OddsPapi documents a free API-key signup and match-winner odds feed. No key is available in this repository/session. Without an accessible external odds feed, match probabilities are left blank; there is no Hotspawn popularity fallback.
flags.source_name: OddsPapi League of Legends odds documentation

flags.title: Prediction market and sportsbook coverage is incomplete by design
flags.detail: Polymarket and sportsbooks do not quote every league/tier. Missing or ambiguous markets remain unresolved; market absence is not converted to a 50% probability. Confirm line availability and jurisdiction at the operator before relying on it.
